packages.title: From outside the app: a second tap never stacks a second form, and the mic never lands on the keyboard
brief: Round 2 of P292's UX-2110 (S1, failed once: partly fixed, verify-b3-r1-A.md) together with its regression UX-2637 (S2, R1A-2). Keep what P292 built: `_entrySheets`, the share path, `_CaptureSheetRoute._open`, `_empty`, `_markEmpty` (App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart:200-249, :2246-2249, set each build at :2263) and the check in `_openEntries` (App/lib/main.dart:188-196). The 'P292 · one sheet per double tap' tests (App/test/capture_sheet_test.dart:3457-3525) keep passing. No copy, no ARB change, no Kotlin.

What round 1 missed (UX-2110): `showCaptureSheet` returns `openTaskForm` for a free account's TEXT entry, and for a VOICE entry when the mic isn't available or free dictations are used up (voice_task_screen.dart:91-103). `openTaskForm` pushes `/newTask` unawaited and returns at once (App/lib/widgets/task_form_entry.dart:63-79), so `_entrySheets` is back to 0 and the top route isn't a `_CaptureSheetRoute`: a double tap on «Escribir una tarea» (free) or on the widget (free, 0 left) still stacks two forms, and Back on the top one shows the second. Free accounts are the newcomer's default.

What round 1 broke (UX-2637, R1A-2): the check absorbs a VOICE entry into any empty capture sheet, including the typing sheet, which has no mic (`waiting` needs `!_typing`, voice_task_screen.dart:2339). Pro, «Escribir una tarea» opened and left empty, later the widget's mic: the keyboard stays and nothing listens.

The rule, settled here (it covers both): an entry other than a share is acknowledged without opening anything only when what's on top is empty AND is what this entry would open itself. (1) VOICE entry, top is an empty capture sheet in voice mode (not `_typing`) → acknowledge. (2) TEXT entry, top is an empty capture sheet in typing mode → acknowledge. (3) The entry would open the form (the same test `showCaptureSheet` makes at :92-95: `typesInFormProvider` and (typing or no `voiceAvailableProvider`)), and top is a new-task form with nothing in its title, or the month's used-up notice an entry opened → acknowledge. (4) Top is an empty capture sheet of the other mode → close that empty sheet first (it holds nothing: Cancelar on it just closes, D1 of 2026-10-18 (night)), then open what the entry asks for, so one sheet shows, in the entry's mode. Anything that holds words (a sheet with words or a result, a form with a title) is never closed or absorbed into: the entry opens over it, as today. This replaces the reviewer's 'a TEXT entry may still be absorbed by any empty sheet': a text entry absorbed by a listening voice sheet would leave the mic live where the person asked to type.

Capture sheets: give `_CaptureSheetRoute` the sheet's mode next to `_empty` (for example `bool _typing`, set in the same `_markEmpty` call each build from `_typing`). Replace `emptyCaptureSheetOnTop(navigator)` with one that says which empty sheet is on top, for example `CaptureMode? emptyCaptureSheetOnTop(NavigatorState navigator)` returning voice, typing or null; keep its doc true. To close an empty one in case (4), pop it from main.dart (`navigator.pop()`, it's the current route); its `whenComplete` already lowers `_entrySheets`. Extract the form test at :92-95 into a public function both `showCaptureSheet` and `_openEntries` use (for example `bool captureOpensForm(ProviderContainer container, {required bool typing})`), so the two can't drift.

Forms: mirror P292 for `/newTask`. Give the route `main.dart:548-556` builds a public class (for example `NewTaskRoute extends MaterialPageRoute<void>` in App/lib/screens/edit_task_screen.dart, used by `onGenerateRoute`) with a static set of open routes (`install`/`dispose`, as `_CaptureSheetRoute._open`) and an `empty` flag that starts true. TaskEditor (App/lib/widgets/task_editor.dart) keeps it current from its title: `_creating && _title.text.trim().isEmpty`, the test D12's `_back` uses to just close (:540-548); a title listener or the build is enough. A public `bool emptyNewTaskFormOnTop(NavigatorState navigator)` answers for the current route. Because the route is installed when it's pushed, before TaskEditor first builds, an entry that arrives in the same pass (two entries already queued when the app resumes) also finds it. The used-up notice (task_form_entry.dart:41-58, shown once a month before the form): while one is open, count it as that form for rule (3), for example with a flag in task_form_entry.dart set around its `showModalBottomSheet`.

`_openEntries` (main.dart:170-245): compute `voice = entry.kind == 'voice'` before the check, apply the rule above, and keep the comment true (UX-2110, UX-2637). `_entrySheets` may stay as it is; the form check doesn't need it. Unchanged: shares always open their own; a VOICE entry onto an empty voice sheet that is idle or paused leaves it showing «Empezar a hablar» (as P292's brief asked); `openTaskForm` still returns at once for its other callers (TaskActions' `_deciding`, the sheet's «Escribir» at voice_task_screen.dart:1981).

Tests: put new tests in a group 'P308 · one entry, one sheet or form' at the end of main() in App/test/capture_sheet_test.dart (Pro, through `_App.open` with `entries:`, `app.entries.queue.add` plus `changed()`, as P292's) and in App/test/capture_free_dictations_test.dart for the free account. Device: the real widget and shortcuts aren't reachable here; say what the emulator should check.
acceptance: Pro, ES 1× on 360×800: a TEXT entry opens the typing sheet; with nothing typed, a VOICE entry 300 ms later leaves exactly one capture sheet on screen, listening (the field is not focused for typing; «Listo» shows); Cancelar → Calendar, with no typing sheet under it.
Pro: a VOICE entry opens the listening sheet; with nothing heard, a TEXT entry 300 ms later leaves exactly one capture sheet, in typing mode; Cancelar → Calendar, with nothing under it.
Pro: two VOICE entries 300 ms apart → one capture sheet; Cancelar → Calendar (P292's test still passes). Two TEXT entries 300 ms apart → one typing sheet.
Pro: a TEXT entry, «pan» typed, then a VOICE entry → a voice sheet opens over it; Cancelar on the voice sheet shows the typing sheet with «pan» still in its field.
Free account with dictations left, ES 1×: two TEXT entries 300 ms apart → one TaskEditor on screen (one '/newTask' route); Back → Calendar.
Free account: two TEXT entries already pending when `_openEntries` runs (both queued before `changed()`) → one TaskEditor.
Free account: a TEXT entry, «Pan» typed as the title, then a TEXT entry → a second, empty form opens over it; Back on it shows the first form with «Pan».

Free account with 0 dictations left, the used-up notice already seen this month: two VOICE entries 300 ms apart → one TaskEditor; Back → Calendar. With the notice not yet seen: two VOICE entries 300 ms apart → one notice; «Crear una tarea» → one TaskEditor.
A share entry that arrives while an empty capture sheet or an empty form is on top still opens its own.
deviceChecks: TaskFlow_Review emulator lane, free account: double-tap the «Escribir una tarea» launcher shortcut → one form; Back → Calendar.
Emulator, Pro: open «Escribir una tarea» from the shortcut, go Home, tap the widget's mic → one sheet, listening.
Emulator: double-tap the widget (Pro, and free with 0 left) → one sheet, or one form.

packages.title: The words' card says «Según tus palabras», whether they were typed or spoken
brief: UX-2636 (S2, regression R1A-1 of P299's UX-2612, verify-b3-r1-A.md). P299 made «Guardar como tarea» show the phone's reading on a card. That reading sets `asTyped`, so the card shows D10's typed-date line under the date (App/lib/widgets/capture_review_editor.dart:506, :353-369): ES «Según lo que has escrito» · «Dejar como está». Before, spoken words read as written were saved at once and this line was rarely seen; now every spoken «Guardar como tarea» card says the person wrote what they said, and TalkBack reads it (AUDIT `capture/result · as-written`, line 4). EN “Keep as typed” has the same problem.

Fix, copy only: word the line for both typed and spoken words. `fromYourWords`: ES «Según tus palabras» (was «Según lo que has escrito»), CA «Segons les teves paraules» (was «Segons el que has escrit»; written by the reviewer, a native read is welcome), EN unchanged “From your words”. `keepAsTyped`: EN “Keep my words” (was “Keep as typed”); ES «Dejar como está» and CA «Deixa-ho com està» unchanged. Keep both key names: no new key. Update the @descriptions in app_en.arb: `@fromYourWords` «Under a date read from the person's words, typed or spoken, before the Keep my words button.»; `@keepAsTyped` «Text button: the words become the title again, without the date read from them.» Run flutter gen-l10n.

D10 (DECISIONS.md, the typed-date decision: «A typed date is applied straight away, with «Dejar como está» one tap away») is unchanged: the line and its button stay where they are and do what they do. Not yours: capture_review_editor.dart's layout and `asTyped` logic, voice_task_screen.dart (P308 beside you).

Tests: App/test/capture_sheet_test.dart:362 asserts the old ES literal, and the U8 / UX-204 test's name (:332) quotes it: update both to «Según tus palabras». Put any new test in a group 'P309 · Según tus palabras' at the end of main(). Re-render `capture/result.as-written` (es 1×, es 2×, ca 2×).
acceptance: `capture/result.as-written`, ES 1× on 360×800: under the date line the card reads «Según tus palabras» and the button «Dejar como está»; the AUDIT's TalkBack list for it contains no «escrito».
Same render at CA 2×: «Segons les teves paraules» and «Deixa-ho com està» whole, nothing clipped.
EN: the line reads “From your words” and its button “Keep my words”.
UX-204 (no Pro, typing «Dentista viernes 10:00», Listo): the card shows «Según tus palabras» · «Dejar como está»; «Dejar como está» restores the words as the title with no date.

packages.title: Completadas: ticking a row you just reopened puts it back where it was
brief: UX-2638 (S1, regression R1B-1 of P300's UX-2311, verify-b3-r1-B.md). On Completadas, a person reopens a row by mistake and ticks its checkbox again (the newcomer's way back, rather than the snackbar's Deshacer). The page passes the reopened row, whose time the Task constructor has already dropped (App/lib/models/task.dart:140-154), so `setCompleted` (App/lib/providers/task_provider.dart:209-238) sends no time and `updateTask` stamps now (`withCompletionTimes`, task.dart:554-578; task_database.dart:573-574). The row stays in place while the page is open (`_doneHere`, App/lib/screens/completed_tasks_screen.dart:39, :103, :141) but is first on the next visit, above what the person really did last.

Fix: carry the time Completadas remembers back into the tick. (1) `setCompleted(Task occurrence, bool completed, {DateTime? at})`: when completing, `at` wins over the passed row's own time: `completed ? (at ?? occurrence.completedTimes[key]) : null` for a repetition, `completed ? (at ?? occurrence.completedAt) : null` otherwise; update its comment. (2) `TaskInteractions.toggle(..., {DateTime? doneAt})` (App/lib/widgets/task_interactions.dart:14-44) passes `at: doneAt` only on the tick (`!task.isCompleted`); its Deshacer is unchanged. (3) TaskTile (App/lib/widgets/task_tile.dart:17-27, toggle at :207-212) gets a field for it (for example `final DateTime? doneAt;` documented as «the time an open row on Completadas was done at, given back when it is ticked again»), passed to `toggle`. (4) TaskList (App/lib/widgets/task_list.dart:81-87) passes `completedTime?.call(task)` to TaskTile when the row isn't completed; only Completadas passes `completedTime`, so every other screen still stamps now. Keep completed_tasks_screen.dart's comment (:33-38) true.

Accepted, not fixed: a completion from before schema 21 (no time) that is reopened and then undone with Deshacer is stamped now; the contract has no way to send «no time» (Backend/docs/COMPLETION_TIMES.md), and it only affects completions from before the update. No server change, no copy, no ARB change. Not yours: the order rule in task_list.dart:41-62, the database and the model.

Tests: a group 'P310 · re-ticking on Completadas keeps the time' at the end of main() in App/test/calendar_feedback_test.dart, with `TaskDatabase.forTesting(sql)..clock = () => …` to set the stamp and `isAtSameMomentAs` to compare times (P300's notes). UX-2304's and UX-2311's tests keep passing.
acceptance: Completadas, ES 1× on 360×800, three non-repeating tasks ticked at 09:00, 10:00 and 11:00: reopen the 10:00 row with its checkbox, then tick that checkbox again with the clock at 12:00: the stored `completedAt` is 10:00, and after leaving the page and coming back the order is 11:00, 10:00, 09:00.

Same with a repeating task's occurrence ticked at 10:00 among two other timed rows: after reopen and re-tick, its `completedTimes` entry for that date is 10:00 and it keeps its place on the next visit.
Ticking an open task on Calendar or Tareas at 12:00 still stores 12:00.
On Completadas, Deshacer after a reopen still restores the original time (P300's test passes).

packages.title: The project sheet shows its last row whole
brief: UX-2639 (S1, regression R1C-1 of P294's UX-2514, verify-b3-r1-C.md). P294 gave the project sheet a drag handle and a «Proyecto» heading (App/lib/widgets/task_list_picker.dart:47-62). The sheet isn't `isScrollControlled`, so Flutter caps it at 9/16 of the screen (450 dp on 360×800); the content grew about 24 dp, and with the preview's five projects «Nuevo proyecto» (the last `ListTile`, `context.l10n.newList`, :118-124) shows 34 of its 56 dp. AUDIT flags «Nuevo proyecto» at 360 × 34 dp.

Fix, as the «¿Quién es responsable?» sheet already does (App/lib/widgets/task_assignment_picker.dart:137-145): `isScrollControlled: true` on the `showModalBottomSheet`, and the `ListView` (still `shrinkWrap: true`) inside `ConstrainedBox(constraints: BoxConstraints(maxHeight: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * .7))`, inside the SafeArea. Keep the handle, the heading, the ✓ rows and the row order. No copy.

Tests: a group 'P311 · project sheet height' at the end of main() in App/test/voice_command_cards_test.dart (or the file holding the UX-2514 project-sheet tests). Re-render `notes/note.project-sheet` as it is (no new preview state).
acceptance: Project sheet with five projects, ES 1× on 360×800 (`notes/note.project-sheet`): «Nuevo proyecto» is a whole 360 × 56 dp row inside the sheet, and AUDIT has no target flag for it.
With one project, ES 1×: the sheet hugs its content (it is shorter than half the screen).
With twelve projects, ES 2× on 360×800: the sheet is no taller than 70% of the screen and its list scrolls to «Nuevo proyecto».

packages.title: The Pro screen shows your plan first, and its benefit checks stay small at large text
brief: UX-2640 (S1, regression R1D-1 of P290's UX-2603, verify-b3-r1-D.md). In `settings/pro.free.es.light.2x` and `.ca.light.2x` the three benefit rows (App/lib/screens/subscription_screen.dart:115-150) take 10–11 lines: the check icon scales to 40 dp (`MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context).scale(20)`, :133-137) plus a 10 dp gap. «No hay una suscripción Pro activa» starts at the bottom edge, cut by the pinned «Ver suscripción», and the «Dictados gratis: …» line needs a scroll. The person came to see what they have left.

Fix, both parts, settled here. (1) Don't scale the icon: 20 dp at every text size, level with the first line of its text (for example a SizedBox as tall as that line's scaled height with the icon centred in it). (2) Move the status block above the benefit list, for every account: the status (`subscription-status`, :151-165), the renewal date (:166-177), `freeLines` (:178-184) and the full-space «Ver tareas con archivos» button (:185-196) now come first, after the reason heading and its example when there is one (:97-114), then 20 dp, then the benefits (or `billingComplimentary`). Your plan first, then what Pro gives, then the button. If at CA 2× on 360×800 the first benefit line no longer fits whole above the pinned button, move only the storage line and its button back below the benefits, for free accounts, and say so in your notes. Update the comments; the Semantics wrapper and the reason's own-node reading stay as they are. No copy, no ARB change.

Tests that may rightly break: UX-1613's 2× fold test (App/test/subscription_screen_test.dart:552-600) must still pass as written (the first benefit line and «Ver suscripción» in view); any order check between the benefits and the status. Put new tests in a group 'P312 · plan first' at the end of main(). Previews: re-render `settings/pro.*` (free es 1×, es 2×, ca 2×; free-used-up; active and complimentary as they exist) and `reminders/sheet.pro-screen` (es 1×); keep their descriptions in settings_previews.dart and reminders_previews.dart true to the new order.
acceptance: Free account, 4 dictations left, ES 2× and CA 2× on 360×800: «No hay una suscripción Pro activa» / «No hi ha cap subscripció Pro activa» and the whole «Dictados gratis: …» / «Dictats gratis: …» line are in view above the pinned «Ver suscripción», with no scrolling, and the first benefit line is whole in view too (UX-1613).
Every benefit row's check icon is 20 × 20 dp at 1× and at 2×, and its vertical centre is within 4 dp of the centre of its text's first line.
Free account, ES 1×: top to bottom, the status, «Dictados gratis: …», «Archivos: … MB usados», then the three benefit lines.
Opened from «A tu manera» (ES 1×): the reason heading and its example first, then the status, then only the first two benefit lines.
Pro account: «Pro está activo» and its renewal date come before the benefit lines.
